design.name: 熔炉铁牛
design.brief: A colossal cast-iron furnace ox (熔炉铁牛), modelled on the Tang-dynasty cast-iron river-guardian oxen (镇河铁牛) and cast in the fire god's forge with a living furnace inside: a massive ox about 4 m long and 2.4 m at the shoulder with real cattle anatomy (huge shoulder hump, deep dewlap, thick legs with big cloven hooves, a broad low head with short thick forward-curving horns, a heavy tufted tail). Its whole body is rough black cast iron in big riveted plates with sparse rust-red wear, heavy chains wrapped around its neck and horns. Its flanks are built-in pleated iron bellows panels that swell when it breathes. In the middle of its chest, below the neck, sits a round heavy bronze furnace door with a beast-face grille; when it raises its head the door swings open and the white-hot furnace mouth inside glows yellow-orange (weak spot, on the FRONT). Lava-orange glow leaks from the plate seams, nostrils and eyes. Slow, unstoppable, oppressive.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert and frost rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, golden snub-nosed monkey): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Iron, basalt and bronze as a few big faceted plates with sparse painted wear; lava and fire painted as OPAQUE glowing cracks, seams and solid sculpted flame shapes (never transparent fire, smoke or particles); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps. Its defence is part of its own body: it holds NO shield and NO weapon.
design.turnaround_pose: standing ON ALL FOURS like a real ox (quadruped), body level, the four thick legs straight under the body and planted, front and hind legs clearly separated with a gap of air between them, belly clear of the ground; head held level facing straight ahead, horns forward; the chest furnace door CLOSED with only a thin glowing orange rim (painted opaque, no halo); the bellows panels on the flanks relaxed; the tail hanging straight down behind; no smoke, no flames, no sparks
design.turnaround_digits: each foot with two cloven hoof toes; horns, chains and the whole tail fully inside the frame; in the side views the long body must fit inside the view with margin.
